stories.title: European leaders say they are ready to negotiate with Russia on Ukraine war
stories.summary: At the Berlin “Coalition of the Willing” summit, European leaders announced they are prepared to enter talks with Russia to end the war in Ukraine. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Europe has a clear, consistent and united negotiating position, and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said Moscow’s maximalist demands are unrealistic. US envoy Jared Kushner said President Trump wants a deal with Moscow “with Europe by his side,” while President Vladimir Putin has so far rejected any European role in US‑led peace talks.
stories.why: It signals a possible shift toward diplomatic engagement that could affect the conflict’s trajectory.

stories.title: Oil prices rise modestly as Houthi attacks on Riyadh spark supply worries
stories.summary: Oil prices saw a slight uptick after recent Houthi strikes on Riyadh raised concerns about possible supply disruptions. Crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz have returned to pre‑war levels, while both Brent and WTI benchmarks were declining earlier in the week. An OPEC+ meeting later this month could lead to adjustments in production policy.
stories.why: The move shows how geopolitical tensions can quickly affect oil market expectations.

stories.title: Positive Breakout: These 5 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
stories.summary: In the Nifty 500 pack, five stocks gained over 7% and their closing prices crossed above their respective 200-day moving averages (DMA) on November 19, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

stories.title: India needs $430 bn in exports by March to meet FY27 target
stories.summary: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India must achieve about $430 billion in exports between November and March to meet its FY 2026‑27 export goal. By the end of October the country had already reached roughly 57 % of that target, with October exports hitting a record near $90 billion. Goyal also reaffirmed an overall fiscal‑year export target of $1 trillion.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
